name: myocyte enhancer factor 2D
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: MEF2D encodes myocyte-specific enhancer factor 2D. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and cell differentiation.
